decisions: Reverse all 64 LEDs: column anodes, row cathodes; positions/pin assignments retained conceptually.
PMOS gates driven by HC138 through 1k series; 10k gate-source pulls.
MCU sinks each row through 680 ohm; 10k pull-up on MCU side blanks during reset.
PC5/PC6/PC7 addresses use open drain and 4.7k pull-ups to avoid loaded VOH ambiguity.
Separate active-low PWM firmware; never flash it onto original v3 wiring.
3.3V HC138 drive/transition behavior, MOSFET settling, MCU total current and brightness require physical verification.
No CAD source promotion to parent seed, no shared inventory updates, no hardware operations.
